name: Anantara Vilamoura Algarve Resort
insider_take: Where championship golf meets golden coastlines in Portugal's premier luxury playground
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on the renowned Victoria Golf Course, designed by Arnold Palmer, and is just minutes from Vilamoura Marina - one of Europe's largest and most prestigious yacht harbors. The property seamlessly blends Thai-inspired Anantara hospitality with authentic Portuguese charm, offering direct access to Falésia Beach's dramatic red cliffs and golden sands.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the marina followed by a nightcap at the resort's rooftop bar - you'll witness the spectacular transition from day to night over the Atlantic while enjoying some of the Algarve's finest cuisine.
dont_miss: The resort's signature spa treatments incorporating Portuguese sea salt and local olive oil, plus early morning walks along Falésia Beach when the limestone cliffs glow pink in the sunrise. Golf enthusiasts should experience both the Victoria and Old Course Vilamoura for two distinctly different championship experiences.
pros: Prime Vilamoura location with easy access to marina, golf courses, and beaches
Luxury Anantara brand service and amenities including world-class spa
Multiple dining options with Mediterranean and international cuisine
Family-friendly facilities with kids' club and pool areas
cons: Popular resort area can be busy during peak season
